verdict.rationale: The pack has no OpenAI-compatible endpoint and no migration or adapter guide from other providers' SDKs. The "drop-in replacement is possible" line (llama-docs-1/15) is about upgrading from earlier Llama versions to Llama 3.1, not about compatibility with OpenAI tooling. Partner hosting (AWS, Azure, Groq, etc.) is a host-platform capability, not Llama's own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform, or follow a documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs
